in_marathi.name: Arpitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arpitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arpitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arpitah', meaning one who is devoted or pleasing to the gods. In Hindu mythology, Arpitha is considered a divine grace, bestowing blessings upon those who seek it.
